blocks.text: Exercise 1. a) ⁧عِشْرِينَ كِتَابًا⁩ · b) ⁧خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ طَالِبًا⁩ · c) ⁧كَمْ سَاعَةً⁩ · d) ⁧أَرْبَعِينَ دَقِيقَةً⁩ · e) ⁧كَمْ لُغَةً⁩ · f) ⁧سِتُّونَ سَنَةً⁩ Exercise 2. a) ⁧هٰذَا الدَّرْسُ أَكْثَرُ أَهَمِّيَّةً مِنَ الدَّرْسِ السَّابِقِ.⁩ · b) ⁧هٰذِهِ الشَّقَّةُ أَكْثَرُ رَاحَةً مِنَ الشَّقَّةِ القَدِيمَةِ.⁩ · c) ⁧المَسْأَلَةُ أَكْثَرُ تَعْقِيدًا مِنْ أَمْسِ.⁩ · d) ⁧الطَّرِيقُ أَكْثَرُ خُطُورَةً فِي اللَّيْلِ⁩ . (also ⁧أَشَدُّ خُطُورَةً⁩ ) · e) ⁧هٰذَا الكَاتِبُ أَقَلُّ شُهْرَةً مِنْ أَخِيهِ.⁩ · f) ⁧هٰذِهِ المَدِينَةُ الأَكْثَرُ جَمَالًا فِي البَلَدِ⁩ . (also: ⁧أَجْمَلُ مَدِينَةٍ فِي البَلَدِ⁩ Exercise 3. a) ⁧اِزْدَادَ الوَضْعُ سُوءًا.⁩ · b) ⁧تَضَاعَفَ عَدَدُ السُّيَّاحِ.⁩ · c) ⁧اِزْدَادَتِ المُشْكِلَةُ تَعْقِيدًا.⁩ · d) ⁧اِزْدَادَتِ المَدِينَةُ جَمَالًا.⁩ · e) ⁧اِزْدَادَتِ الأَسْعَارُ ارْتِفَاعًا.⁩ · f) ⁧اِزْدَادَ الطَّقْسُ بَرْدًا.⁩ Exercise 4. a) ⁧اِرْتَفَعَتِ الأَسْعَارُ ارْتِفَاعًا كَبِيرًا.⁩ · b) ⁧رَحَّبَ بِنَا تَرْحِيبًا حَارًّا.⁩ · c) ⁧تَحَسَّنَ الطَّقْسُ تَحَسُّنًا تَدْرِيجِيًّا.⁩ · d) ⁧اِنْخَفَضَ عَدَدُ الحَوَادِثِ انْخِفَاضًا مَلْحُوظًا.⁩ · e) ⁧شَكَرْتُهَا شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا.⁩ · f) ⁧اِسْتَعَدَّ الفَرِيقُ لِلْمُبَارَاةِ اسْتِعْدَادًا جَيِّدًا.⁩ Exercise 5. a) ḥālHe's tired again. b) tamyīz: I bought thirty pens. c) absolute complement: d) tamyīzIt's older than me. e) absolute complement: ... he slept deeply. f) ḥāl: "She came in smiling." g) tamyīzTime has become even warmer.
h) absolute complement (emphasis): .g. they have taste rice.

Exercise 6 · Examples. a) from ( ⁧أَشْكُرُكَ⁩ ) ⁧شُكْرًا⁩ : ⁧شُكْرًا عَلَى الهَدِيَّةِ.⁩ · b) By nature: ⁧طَبْعًا سَأَحْضُرُ.⁩ · c) "Really" is: ⁧الفِيلْمُ جَمِيلٌ جِدًّا.⁩ · d) Returning (on what has been said) ⁧أَنَا أَيْضًا مِنْ مِيلَانُو.⁩ · e) In truth, the following is added: ⁧هٰذَا حَقًّا مُهِمٌّ.⁩ · f) from ( ⁧أَعْفُو⁩ ) ⁧عَفْوًا⁩ Forgiveness: ⁧عَفْوًا، أَيْنَ المَحَطَّةُ؟⁩ Exercise 7. a) ⁧كَمْ شَخْصًا جَاءَ؟⁩ · b) ⁧القِطَارُ أَسْرَعُ وَأَكْثَرُ رَاحَةً.⁩ · c) ⁧المَسْأَلَةُ الأَكْثَرُ تَعْقِيدًا⁩ (also: ⁧أَكْثَرُ المَسَائِلِ تَعْقِيدًا⁩ ) ·
d) ⁧اِنْخَفَضَتِ الأَسْعَارُ انْخِفَاضًا طَفِيفًا.⁩ · e) ⁧رَحَّبُوا بِنَا تَرْحِيبًا حَارًّا.⁩ · f) ⁧اِزْدَادَ الوَضْعُ سُوءًا.⁩ · g) ⁧هُوَ قَرَارٌ بَالِغُ الأَهَمِّيَّةِ.⁩ · h) ⁧نَامَ⁩

Exercise 8. a) ⁧عِشْرِينَ كِتَابًا⁩ · b) ⁧كَمْ كِتَابًا⁩ · c) ⁧أَكْثَرُ أَهَمِّيَّةً⁩ · d) ⁧ارْتِفَاعًا كَبِيرًا⁩ · e) ⁧أَكْثَرُ أَهَمِّيَّةً⁩ · f) ⁧شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا⁩ Exercise 9. a) A record of visitors: more than two million tourists, the 30% more than the previous year. b) The revenue has increased greatly and the small hotels in the historic center have doubled over five years. c) Because transport has improved considerably, flights are cheaper and cheaper to stay than in nearby coastal cities. d) More crowded roads and rents climbed abruptly: life is harder for the inhabitants. The inhabitant wonders how many years they can stay: the houses are now for tourists. e) He studies a plan to regulate short rents, an issue of extreme importance. f) Tamyīz: ⁧أَكْثَرُ جَاذِبِيَّةً⁩ More attractive than that ⁧أَقَلُّ تَكْلِفَةً⁩ It costs less. ⁧اِزْدَادَتِ الشَّوَارِعُ ازْدِحَامًا⁩ The roads have become more crowded. ⁧أَكْثَرَ صُعُوبَةً⁩ More difficult than that ⁧كَمْ سَنَةً⁩ • how many years • ⁧بَالِغَةُ الأَهَمِّيَّةِ⁩ ( iḍāfa with a value of tamyīz) is very important. Absolute complements: ⁧اِرْتَفَعَتْ⁩ … ⁧ارْتِفَاعًا كَبِيرًا⁩ • they have increased very much · ⁧تَحَسَّنَتْ⁩ … ⁧تَحَسُّنًا مَلْحُوظًا⁩ It has improved considerably · ⁧اِنْخَفَضَتْ⁩ … ⁧انْخِفَاضًا طَفِيفًا⁩ • have dropped slightly · ⁧اِرْتَفَعَتْ⁩ … ⁧ارْتِفَاعًا حَادًّا⁩ They went up abruptly. Exercise 10. 1. Last month, food prices rose sharply. 2. The case became complicated after new evidence appeared. 3. The President warmly welcomed the delegation and stressed that relations between the two countries are of extreme importance. 4. How many years does the country need to deal with unemployment? 5. After the heavy rains, the situation has worsened further. 6. In ten years the number of foreign students in the university has doubled. Delicate points: in 2 ⁧أَصْبَحَتْ أَكْثَرَ تَعْقِيدًا⁩ It is good with a verb: it is complicated. in 4 ⁧لِكَيْ يُعَالِجَ⁩ : (a) to address / resolve (b) not to cure (c) in 5 ⁧اِزْدَادَ⁩ … ⁧سُوءًا⁩ It has deteriorated again, or more so.
⁧أَسْكُنُ فِي مِيلَانُو، وَأَعْمَلُ أَحْيَانًا فِي رُومَا، لِذٰلِكَ أَعْرِفُ المَدِينَتَيْنِ مَعْرِفَةً جَيِّدَةً. رُومَا أَكْبَرُ مِسَاحَةً وَأَكْثَرُ⁩
⁧جَمَالًا، فِي رَأْيِي، وَلٰكِنَّ مِيلَانُو أَكْثَرُ تَنْظِيمًا. فِي مِيلَانُو المُوَاصَلَاتُ أَسْرَعُ وَأَقَلُّ ازْدِحَامًا، وَالمِتْرُو أَكْثَرُ رَاحَةً.⁩
⁧أَمَّا الحَيَاةُ فِي مِيلَانُو فَهِيَ أَكْثَرُ تَكْلِفَةً: اِرْتَفَعَتْ أَسْعَارُ الإِيجَارِ ارْتِفَاعًا حَادًّا فِي السَّنَوَاتِ الأَخِيرَةِ، وَازْدَادَتِ⁩
⁧المَدِينَةُ غَلَاءً. كَمْ يُورُو يَدْفَعُ الطُّلَّابُ لِغُرْفَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ؟ أَحْيَانًا سِتَّمِئَةٍ! وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ تَحَسَّنَتْ مِيلَانُو تَحَسُّنًا⁩
⁧مَلْحُوظًا: حَدَائِقُ جَدِيدَةٌ وَمَتَاحِفُ وَأَحْيَاءٌ أَكْثَرُ حَيَوِيَّةً. أُحِبُّ المَدِينَتَيْنِ حُبًّا كَبِيرًا، وَلٰكِنَّ رُومَا تَبْقَى الأَجْمَلَ.⁩

⁧المُوَاصَلَات⁩ Transport ⁧غَلَاء⁩ Carovita (carovit) ⁧وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ⁩ However, this subheading does not cover: ⁧حَيَوِيَّة⁩ It's liveliness. Exercise 12. a) Three: one direct and two with a stopover (Istanbul and Athens). The direct lasts three and a half hours and costs 320 euro. Via Istanbul costs much less but lasts about eleven hours, with seven hours of call. Via Athens lasts six hours and has an average price, but the company is little known. Direct: it costs more, but it is more comfortable and Luca will come less tired. b) It's improved a lot. Wrong Agreements ( ⁧الأَسْعَارُ ارْتَفَعُوا⁩ ). Listen with more focus: sometimes he answers before understanding the question. Prepare well, because Cairo is spoken quickly. "You're welcome, it's my duty" ( ⁧لَا شُكْرَ عَلَى وَاجِبٍ⁩ ). c) 1. Gasoline: slight increase; electricity: significant decline. 2. Electric cars doubled in two years, and now they cost less. 3. The stock exchange has gradually improved; next year should be more stable. 17. The number of visitors has doubled. · 18. The train is more comfortable than the bus. · 19. They welcomed us. Warmly. · 20. The city recorded a record.
